أَسْخَمُ Black; (S, K;) like أَسْحَمُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- [The fem.] سَخْمَآءُ is said to be applied to wine (خَمْر) as meaning Inclining to blackness: but what has been said above [app. as to the word and the meaning] is more approved. (TA.) ―
-b3- Also, applied to a [stony tract such as is termed] حَرَّة, Of which what is smooth, or soft, or plain, thereof, is intermixed with what is rugged. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
